ValidationRule.description: If lead status is Nurturing,Unqualified provide reason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.LeadValidations__c ) , NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Lead_Provide_Reason ) , OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Nurturing' ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( NSP_Reason__c ) ) ) , AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Unqualified' ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( NSP_Reason__c ) ) ) ) )
